email_search_note: Deep search performed: Google Business Profile (no email field), no Facebook/Instagram found to check an About/bio section, no linktree, WebSearch for a Sunbiz/Florida corporation record under this name (none surfaced), Groupon merchant page (no email shown, only a deal page). Consistent with the registry pattern for home/trade-adjacent small businesses: phone is the real contact channel.

palette_plan.base_skeleton: templates/dark-v2/index.html (Pure Artistry: dark bg #0f0b07, gold #d4a84b/#b8934a, Booksy 121705, Orlando, hair niche)
palette_plan.method: Programmatic HSL hue-rotation (+229deg) applied to every hex/rgba color in the skeleton's <style> block (gold ~42deg -> violet ~271deg), with the merktop-badge block protected/excluded so it stays gold as required. This produced a consistent, exhaustive purple/violet re-paint (bg, surfaces, text-shine, orbs, buttons, dark-band) without needing a manual color-pair list.
palette_plan.rationale: The business's own real photos show vivid purple-and-black studio walls (confirmed in gmaps-3.jpg and gmaps-1.jpg), so a violet accent on a near-black background matches the real brand environment rather than an invented palette.
